title: Wolf in Cracked Earth
description: A realistic wolf with grey and brown fur lies on dry, cracked ground, looking directly at the viewer with its mouth open. Colorful glowing flowers in purple, orange and yellow grow from the fissures around it, with a torn tag in the foreground.
